arxiv-2104-04739.title: MIPT-NSU-UTMN at SemEval-2021 Task 5: Ensembling Learning with Pre-trained Language Models for Toxic Spans Detection
arxiv-2104-04739.creator: Mikhail Kotyushev, Anna Glazkova, Dmitry Morozov
arxiv-2104-04739.description: Abstract This paper describes our system for SemEval-2021 Task 5 on Toxic Spans Detection. We developed ensemble models using BERT-based neural architectures and post-processing to combine tokens into spans. We evaluated several pre-trained language models using various ensemble techniques for toxic span identification and achieved sizable improvements over our baseline fine-tuned BERT models.

arxiv-2112-02268.description: Abstract . With the great success of pre-trained models, the pretrain-then-finetune paradigm has been widely adopted on downstream tasks for source code understanding. arxiv-2209-12262.title: Multiphoton excitation and high harmonic generation in rectangular graphene quantum dot
arxiv-2209-12262.creator: A G Ghazaryan, Kh V Sedrakian
arxiv-2209-12262.description: Abstract The multiphoton excitation and high harmonic generation (HHG) processes are considered using the microscopic quantum theory of nonlinear interaction of strong coherent electromagnetic (EM) radiation with rectangular graphene quantum dot (RGQD). The dynamic Hartree-Fock approximation is developed for the consideration of the quantum dot-laser field nonlinear interaction at the nonadiabatic multiphoton excitation regime.

arxiv-2210-14778.title: Hubble Space Telescope Reveals Spectacular Light Echoes Associated with the Stripped-envelope Supernova 2016adj in the Iconic Dust Lane of Centaurus A
arxiv-2210-14778.creator: Maximilian D. Stritzinger, Francesco Taddia, Stephen S. Lawrence, F. Patat, Morgan Fraser, Lluís Galbany, Simon Holmbo, Ali Hyder, Emir Karamehmetoglu
arxiv-2210-14778.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Maximilian D. Stritzinger, Francesco Taddia, Stephen S. Lawrence, F. Patat, Morgan Fraser, Lluís Galbany, Simon Holmbo, Ali Hyder, Emir Karamehmetoglu. We present a multi-band sequence of Hubble Space Telescope images documenting the emergence and evolution of multiple light echoes (LEs) linked to the stripped-envelope supernova (SN) 2016adj located in the central dust-lane of Centaurus A. Following point-spread function subtraction, we identify the earliest LE emission associated with a SN at only + + 34 days (d) past the epoch of B B -band maximum.

arxiv-2405-02162.title: Unified Promptable Panoptic Mapping with Dynamic Labeling Using Foundation Models
arxiv-2405-02162.creator: Mohamad Al Mdfaa, Raghad Salameh, Geesara Kulathunga *, Sergey Zagoruyko, Gonzalo Ferrer *
arxiv-2405-02162.description: Abstract Panoptic maps enable robots to reason about both geometry and semantics. However, open-vocabulary models repeatedly produce closely related labels that split panoptic entities and degrade volumetric consistency. The proposed UPPM advances open-world scene understanding by leveraging foundation models to introduce a panoptic Dynamic Descriptor that reconciles open-vocabulary labels with unified category structure and geometric size priors.

arxiv-2410-05873.creator: Amir Hossein Kargaran, Ali Modarressi, Nafiseh Nikeghbal, Jana Diesner, François Yvon, Hinrich Schütze
arxiv-2410-05873.description: Abstract English-centric large language models (LLMs) often show strong multilingual capabilities. However, their multilingual performance remains unclear and is under-evaluated for many other languages. Most benchmarks for multilinguality focus on classic NLP tasks or cover a minimal number of languages.

arxiv-2410-06999.creator: Sean Eberhard, Connor Mellon
arxiv-2410-06999.description: Abstract . The normal covering number γ ⁡ ( G ) \gamma(G) of a noncyclic group G G is the minimum number of proper subgroups whose conjugates cover the group. We give various estimates for γ ⁡ ( S n ) \gamma(S_{n}) and γ ⁡ ( A n ) \gamma(A_{n}) depending on the arithmetic structure of n n .

arxiv-2503-17435.title: Random batch list method for metallic system with embedded atom potential
arxiv-2503-17435.creator: Jieqiong Zhang, Jizu Huang, Zihao Yang
arxiv-2503-17435.description: Abstract The embedded atom method (EAM) is one of the most widely used many-body, short-range potentials in molecular dynamics simulations, particularly for metallic systems. To enhance the efficiency of calculating these short-range interactions, we extend the random batch list (RBL) concept to the EAM potential, resulting in the RBL-EAM algorithm.

arxiv-2505-07946.title: Interplay between Electroweak Symmetry Breaking and Dark Matter Relic Density
arxiv-2505-07946.creator: Sreemanti Chakraborti, André Milagre, Rui Santos, João P. Silva
arxiv-2505-07946.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sreemanti Chakraborti, André Milagre, Rui Santos, João P. Silva. Models of Dark Matter must contend with the fact that the presence of electroweak symmetry breaking along the thermal evolution of the Universe modifies the masses, interactions and, thus, the thermally averaged cross sections. We study in detail the impact of taking (not taking) the presence of the electroweak symmetry breaking into account in the calculations of the Dark Matter relic density, providing a model-independent measure of such differences.

arxiv-2506-08184.title: Unable to Forget: Proactive Interference Reveals Working Memory Limits in LLMs Beyond Context Length
arxiv-2506-08184.creator: Chupei Wang, Jiaqiu Vince Sun
arxiv-2506-08184.description: Abstract Information retrieval in Large Language Models (LLMs) is increasingly recognized as intertwined with generation capabilities rather than mere lookup. While longer contexts are often assumed to improve retrieval, the effects of intra-context interference remain understudied. To address this, we adapt the proactive interference (PI) paradigm from cognitive science, where earlier information disrupts recall of newer updates.
